newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran hit by force 3.8 quake.
newsitem.headline: Iran hit by force 3.8 quake.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 3.8 on the Richter scale jolted the cities of Firouzabad and Kouvar in southern Iran on Saturday, the official IRNA news agency reported.
It said the seismological centre of Shiraz, affiliated to Tehran University, put the time of the earthquake at 00:37 (2007 GMT Friday).
The agency said there has been no report of damage or injury.
Iran has been hit by at least three major earthquakes in the past year as well as scores of tremors and thousands of aftershocks.
